display.purpose: Hero H1 only — the largest, single use of the display role.

headline.purpose: Every SectionTitle; always paired with an italic gold emphasis span.

title.purpose: Treatment-menu row titles, process-step titles, testimonial names, card titles.

body.purpose: Leads and paragraph copy, Manrope, ink-500/ink-700.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked-caps footer column headers only (Navegação, Unidades) — not a section-heading pattern.

shadows.name: soft

shadows.name: gold

components.name: Primary Button (gold)
components.description: Highest-priority CTA per section (hero, featured procedure, Sobre) — gold gradient with matching gold shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Manrope, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 16px 36px; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-gold { background: linear-gradient(135deg,#A97A50 0%,#D3AB84 55%,#F2E3D2 100%); color: #04241A; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px -14px rgba(190,144,102,0.55); } .ds-btn-gold:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 18px 46px -14px rgba(190,144,102,0.65); } .ds-btn-gold:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D3AB84; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-gold:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button (forest)
components.description: Secondary/orientation CTA — green gradient with soft shadow.
components.html: Falar com a Dra. Letícia

components.name: WhatsApp Button
components.description: Solid WhatsApp-green CTA, reserved exclusively for the contact channel.

components.name: Treatment Menu Row
components.description: Signature editorial listing row: italic gold numeral (meaningful sequence), serif title, description, arrow link — used for the 5-item treatment menu.

components.css: .ds-menu-item { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3rem 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 20px; row-gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid #E9DFCF; padding: 28px 0; } .ds-menu-index { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.125rem; color: #BE9066; } .ds-menu-title { grid-column: 2; font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #04241A; } .ds-menu-desc { grid-column: 2; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; color: #6B756E; max-width: 32rem; } .ds-menu-link { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1 / 3; align-self: center; color: #03422F; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-menu-link:hover { color: #028C5C; } .ds-menu-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D3AB84; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gallery Card
components.description: Photo/before-after container: rounded-brand + soft shadow + glass caption pill inset at the bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-gallery-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 20px 55px -22px rgba(4,36,26,0.5); } .ds-gallery-img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; object-fit: cover; display: block; } .ds-gallery-caption { position: absolute; left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: Manrope, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #FBF8F3; background: rgba(4,36,26,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-gallery-label { margin-left: 8px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(244,237,226,0.8); }

components.name: Section Title
components.description: Recurring section heading: serif headline plus an italic gold emphasis phrase — the signature that ties every section together.
components.html: Cada rosto é único — o seu tratamento também é.
components.css: .ds-section-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(2rem,5.4vw,3.1rem); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #04241A; } .ds-section-emphasis { font-style: italic; font-weight: 500; color: #BE9066; }

narrative.overview: The practice reads as a boutique atelier flipping through its own lookbook, not a clinic filling in a template. Every section is a large image-led moment or an editorial listing — a treatment menu, a magazine-style before/after spread, a portrait with a glass caption — never a centered headline stacked over an icon grid. The forest/gold/cream palette and the line-art logo are pre-existing brand commitments and stay fixed; what changed is the composition around them: asymmetric splits, bleed photography, and Playfair Display in place of Cormorant Garamond for every serif headline. Density is generous but not empty: text blocks sit against full-bleed or large-format photography rather than floating alone on cream. The one confirmed rejection is the decorative section eyebrow (a small uppercase kicker label sitting above every heading) — it was built, reviewed, and removed as a craft-floor violation; headings now carry their own weight without it.
keyCharacteristics: Asymmetric, image-led grids in place of the centered-hero-plus-icon-grid template.
Every headline pairs a serif display line with an italic gold "emphasis" phrase.
Numerals are used only where content is genuinely sequential (treatment rows, process steps) — never as decorative section labeling.
Glass captions (translucent forest scrim + backdrop blur) label photography instead of separate text captions.
Pill-shaped buttons and full-bleed photography carry the only shadows; everything else is flat.

rules.name: The Gold-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Gold never fills a large surface on its own — it appears as the italic emphasis word, a hairline divider, a numeral, or the gradient sliver on one CTA per section. It is legible precisely because it is scarce.

rules.name: The Italic Gold Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Every SectionTitle closes on an italic word or phrase in gold (gold-600 on light sections, gold-300 on dark). This is the one recurring signature that ties every section heading together.

rules.name: The Meaningful Numeral Rule
rules.body: Serif italic gold numerals label the treatment-menu rows and the four ComoFunciona steps because that content is genuinely counted and ordered. Numerals are never applied as decorative section labeling — that usage (a numbered eyebrow above headings) was built, reviewed, and removed.

rules.name: The Photography-Lifts, Text-Doesn't Rule
rules.body: Shadows only ever sit under an image container or a button. A text-only card (testimonial) stays flat and gets a border treatment instead.

rules.name: The Two Silhouettes Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a photograph gets rounded-brand + shadow-soft. Anything that is a quote or text block gets square corners + a single gold rule. Don't cross the two.

dos: Do pair every SectionTitle with an italic gold emphasis phrase (the Italic Gold Emphasis Rule).
Do use asymmetric, image-led grids (hero split, lookbook gallery, reversed about split) instead of a centered hero over an icon grid.
Do reserve serif italic gold numerals for content that is genuinely sequential or counted (treatment-menu rows, process steps).
Do keep photographic containers at rounded-brand (22px) + shadow-soft, and give text-only cards square corners + a gold rule instead.
Do keep wa-green exclusive to WhatsApp contact CTAs so it reads as "the contact channel," not a general accent.
donts: Don't add an eyebrow/kicker label above a section heading. The shared Eyebrow component and all its usages were built, then removed after finish review flagged it as a systemic craft-floor violation — it is a defect this build carries the memory of, not a pattern to reintroduce.
Don't use numerals decoratively. A numeral is only earned by content that is actually ordered or counted (five procedures, four steps) — never used to dress up a section label.
Don't apply a drop shadow to a text-only card; shadows are reserved for photographic containers and buttons.
